title: Maxx Crosby: Trade is water under the bridge, I'm in Las Vegas and I want to be here

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Maxx Crosby: Trade is water under the bridge, I'm in Las Vegas and I want to be here
sources.description: "I want to be out there and be part of the team," Crosby said. "I just love what I do and I love playing football and I love being on the field."
